tutorial.welcome_description: Welcome to your vehicle tracking and fuel management app. Let's take a quick tour and introduce you to the features.
tutorial.records_description: Record your fuel purchases here and view your past records. All your fuel expenses are kept here.
tutorial.stations_description: View fuel stations on the map, find the nearest stations, and compare prices.
tutorial.reports_description: Detailed analyses and reports in this section. You can review your fuel consumption, expense graphs, and statistical data here.
tutorial.reminders_description: Manage your important reminders such as vehicle maintenance, insurance renewal, and inspection dates here.
tutorial.settings_description: Manage app settings, profile information, theme preferences, and other settings here.
tutorial.ready_description: You can now start using the app. Start by adding a fuel record right away!
